trust_decision.summary: Whether an opened/compared/schema XML file may process its DTD and resolve external entities is decided by the IgnoreDTD setting in XmlHelpers.CreateXmlSettings (DtdProcessing Ignore vs Parse, resolver only when DTD is enabled); at the pinned commit this hardening is already in place.

landing_point.why: Summary names 'unsafe XmlTextReader in XML Diff'; the only raw XmlTextReader in the diff path is here.

fix_sites.entry_point: XmlHelpers.CreateXmlSettings, used by every file load/diff/schema read (File>Open, Compare, Schemas dialog)
View>Options dialog, Ignore DTD toggle (UI warning prompt only)
View>Options dialog UserSettings.IgnoreDTD setter (UI prompt hook)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The listed fix commits contain no XXE hardening beyond the resolver-when-enabled change; the actual hardening (commit 15c1240, 'Fix issue security advisory on DTD processing') is an ancestor of the pinned commit and is not in the supplied diff.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: XmlCache.Navigator builds an XPathDocument straight from the file name, bypassing IgnoreDTD; a solver could argue it is only used for XPath search, not loading, and that .NET 4.8 defaults already block external resolution.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: With IgnoreDTD=False the user explicitly opts in to DTD parsing and external DTD resolution for trusted DTDs (documented); an over-broad fix that always prohibits DTDs/resolvers breaks this.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: XmlCache.Navigator constructs XPathDocument from the file name without the IgnoreDTD settings
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Read-only XPath helper; framework defaults may already disable external resolution
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same Model package as the helper, different file

O8_uncovered_routes.route: XSLT stylesheet DOM reloaded with XmlDocument.Load(uri) after the hardened reader path
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Stylesheet, not the document; XmlDocument resolver default is null on .NET 4.8
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: XmlNotepad package, different from Application landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: XInclude reader opens included files with caller-supplied settings
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: XInclude is a neighbouring feature; settings come from callers

O8b_injection_room.sibling: diffgram reader built from separately constructed XmlReaderSettings instead of model.GetReaderSettings()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The diff code already mixes XmlReader.Create with a raw XmlTextReader at :114, so a second hand-built reader is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: XmlStats reader path that forgets DtdProcessing.Ignore on one overload
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Two near-duplicate XmlTextReader blocks set DtdProcessing by hand; easy to drop one.

O9_family: XXE / external entity and DTD resolution (CWE-611)

O10_build.project_tests: src/UnitTests/UnitTest1.cs (MSTest, GUI-driven UI automation; DTD-related test near src/UnitTests/UnitTest1.cs:2719-2722)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set DtdProcessing.Prohibit and XmlResolver=null everywhere, breaking the documented opt-in DTD processing.

out_of_scope_notes: Updater loads a remote updates.xml with plain XmlDocument.Load (src/Model/Updater.cs:194-199); different trust boundary (update feed), not pursued.
